annotations.title: Get back into a book when the handle is gone.

description: Given the email address a book belongs to, Chorus emails that address a six digit code and returns nothing about the books. Given the address and the code, it returns every book on that account with its handle. Holding the mailbox is the proof, so a book cannot be found by guessing an address.

code.description: The six digit code that was emailed. Without it, Chorus emails one.

email.description: The email address the book belongs to.
